days.title: Clear Expression - Saying What You Mean
days.learning_objective: Develop the skill of expressing ideas clearly and precisely so others understand your intended meaning.

days.title: Active Listening - Hearing What Others Mean
days.learning_objective: Practice active listening—fully attending to and understanding what others communicate, not just waiting to respond.

days.title: Reading for Understanding - Comprehension Strategies
days.learning_objective: Apply strategies for deep reading comprehension: previewing, annotating, questioning, summarizing.

days.title: Writing to Be Understood - Clarity in Writing
days.learning_objective: Write for clarity and understanding, organizing ideas logically and using accessible language.

days.title: Speaking with Impact - Verbal Communication
days.learning_objective: Develop speaking skills that engage listeners and communicate ideas effectively.

days.title: Body Language - Non-Verbal Communication
days.learning_objective: Understand how body language communicates and learn to read and use non-verbal cues effectively.

days.title: Emotional Tone - The Feeling Behind Words
days.learning_objective: Recognize that how we say things carries as much meaning as what we say.

days.title: Context and Communication - Same Words, Different Meanings
days.learning_objective: Understand how context shapes meaning and learn to consider context when communicating and interpreting.

days.title: Audience Awareness - Adapting to Who's Listening
days.learning_objective: Adapt communication style and content to suit different audiences and their needs.

days.title: Feedback Loops - Checking Understanding
days.learning_objective: Build feedback loops into communication to verify that messages are received as intended.

days.title: Communicating with AI - How to Prompt Effectively
days.learning_objective: Apply communication principles to AI interactions, crafting clear and effective prompts.

days.title: Interpreting AI Output - Reading AI Responses Critically
days.learning_objective: Develop skills for critically reading and interpreting AI-generated content.

days.title: AI Translation - Communicating Across Languages
days.learning_objective: Use AI translation tools effectively while understanding their limitations and potential errors.

days.title: AI Summarization - Condensing Information
days.learning_objective: Use AI to summarize content while verifying that key points are accurately captured.

days.title: Information Overload - Dealing with Too Much Input
days.learning_objective: Develop strategies for managing information overload and filtering what deserves attention.

days.title: Signal vs Noise - Finding What Matters
days.learning_objective: Distinguish important information (signal) from irrelevant content (noise) in communications.

days.title: Persuasion - Ethical Influence
days.learning_objective: Understand ethical persuasion techniques that respect autonomy while effectively communicating ideas.

days.title: Manipulation - Recognizing Unethical Influence
days.learning_objective: Identify manipulation tactics in communication and develop resistance to unethical influence.

days.title: Argumentation - Making and Evaluating Arguments
days.learning_objective: Construct sound arguments and evaluate the logic and evidence in others' arguments.

days.title: Debate - Structured Disagreement
days.learning_objective: Practice productive debate that explores ideas rather than attacks people.

days.title: Difficult Conversations - Navigating Conflict
days.learning_objective: Develop skills for having difficult conversations with respect and clarity.

days.title: Empathetic Communication - Understanding Others' Perspectives
days.learning_objective: Communicate with empathy, seeking to understand others' viewpoints and feelings.

days.title: Cross-Cultural Communication - Different Contexts, Different Norms
days.learning_objective: Navigate cultural differences in communication styles, expectations, and norms.

days.title: Digital Communication - Text, Email, Social Media
days.learning_objective: Communicate effectively in digital contexts where tone and non-verbal cues are limited.

days.title: Visual Communication - Charts, Graphs, Infographics
days.learning_objective: Use visual elements to communicate data and ideas clearly and persuasively.

days.title: Storytelling - Narrative as Communication
days.learning_objective: Harness the power of storytelling to communicate ideas in memorable and meaningful ways.

days.title: Teaching - Communicating to Help Others Learn
days.learning_objective: Apply communication skills specifically for teaching—explaining, modeling, and guiding understanding.

days.title: Asking for Help - Effective Requests
days.learning_objective: Learn to ask for help effectively, clearly communicating what you need and why.

days.title: Communication Mistakes - Learning from Errors
days.learning_objective: Analyze communication breakdowns to learn and improve future interactions.

days.title: Month in Review - The Art of Communication
days.learning_objective: Synthesize communication skills into an integrated practice for all interactions.
